items.title: Tom Porrello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 6, 2023
items.q: I’d be with Harry’s band and Frank Sinatra Junior would come in with somebody — I got two days, three days at the most I’d get a call.

ctx.x: The lounges are all like 300, 400 seaters. But we would play at the Flamingo Hotel, we played on the high stage and below us was the bar, and above us was like a dome. And it had corks like hanging — short ones, short ones, to like keep the sound down so it wasn’t too loud in the casino. So it was a hard place to play. But every time, it would never fail, I’d be with Harry’s band and Frank Sinatra Junior would come in with somebody — I got two days, three days at the most I’d get a call. Ring. Can you come in,…
chops. You know. It was a hard place to play. But again, you’ve got to keep an open mind. You’ve got to pace yourself. You’ve got to know how much to give and how much to ease off.
